Diagnosis: Multiple position constraints were specified: both 'reach_distance' and 'freeze_position'. The API allows at most one position constraint across all constraints, but both were included, causing a conflict.
Reasoning: Success for this subtask requires: (1) the tool (panda_fingertip) is retracted away from cube_1 along the tool's +z axis in the agent/robot frame by at least 0.075 m, reaching a standoff position where the distance from the tool frame origin to the center of cube_1 is at least 0.075 m (with a reasonable tolerance); (2) throughout, the tool orientation in the agent/robot frame must not change (freeze orientation); (3) the gripper must remain fully open (gripper joints at or near maximum open, with force/effort at free-space levels); and (4) end motion at the above position with no contact/effort relative to cube_1 (i.e., low manipulator effort). Only one position constraint is allowed, so 'freeze_position' is removed. All constraints are combined with 'and' logic because all conditions must simultaneously hold for success.
